name: mac
description: MAC — Music Assistant Controller for Elgato Stream Deck (monorepo)
author: Boris Kemper

scripts.build: npm run build -w music-assistant-client -w streamdeck-core && npm run build -w mac-plugin && node tools/build-translator.mjs
scripts.watch: npm run build -w music-assistant-client -w streamdeck-core && npm run watch -w mac-plugin
scripts.sim:all: npm run sim:play-pause && npm run sim:keys && npm run sim:play-item && npm run sim:dials && npm run sim:browser && npm run sim:players && npm run sim:queue-group && npm run sim:extras && npm run sim:continue
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck -w music-assistant-client && npm test && npm run lint && npm run validate -w mac-plugin
scripts.ship:patch: npm run check && npm run version:patch && npm run release
scripts.ship:minor: npm run check && npm run version:minor && npm run release
scripts.ship:major: npm run check && npm run version:major && npm run release
scripts.ship:beta: npm run check && npm run version:beta && npm run release
